ResearchTabDef.label: EcoTech: Lithic
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Unlock lithic terratech projects, such as those based on crystals, metals, and precious ores.\n\nYou can have both a basic and an advanced project active at the same time. If no advanced project is active, advanced research will contribute to a basic project instead.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Terratech Essentials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study proper lithic terratech fundamentals, and learn how to create a crucible that let's you apply it all. Just as importantly, this will teach you how to grow terrathyst, which is essential in creating lithic items. Lithic terratech has it's own unique upsides and downsides, which tribes might prefer over organic matter. It's is quite straightforward and highly durable, but takes much more time and material investment.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You can now create a terrathyst crucible, and growths of terrathyst, which is your primary method of creating crystal-based structures and weapons. These are easy to grow, and don't require high fertility. They will grow in glowsap and shocksap bays. This crucible is used to form terrathyst seeds, and to charge or manipulate certain terrathyst items. It's usability is quite limited, however, and stronger, deeper structures are needed for larger items, and more demanding recipes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Essentials: Terrasaps
ResearchProjectDef.description: Lithic terratech requires a couple specific terrasaps. This research will teach you extract them from the planet, and how to create the appropriate terrasap bays.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: While not used as commonly as in organic terratech, specific terrasaps are used due to their helpful effects. Some are even almost exclusviely used in lithic terratech. Shocksap is the most common, used to stimulate crystal growth and create electrical charge. Endosap is used for hardening purposes, generally for weaponry and armor. Embersap and cryosap may be used for temperature control or metallugry, and so on.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Weapon Crafting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teaches you how to make lithic weapon for the foreseeable future, and also teaches you how make a couple weapons at the terrathyst crucible. While the weapons can be made at the crucible, upgrading them to stronger stages requires a different structure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Armor Crafting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teaches you how to make lithic armor for the foreseeable future, and also teaches you how make the armor at the terrathyst crucible. \n(Dev note: Lithic armor will be upgradable, but there wasn't enough time to finish the art.)

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Charge Manipulation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teaches how to both recharge and evolve usable gear at lithic structures that can pool terrasaps.

customUnlockTexts.li: Restoring weapons at the terrathyst crucible
Restoring weapons at the chronite forge

ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Lithic creations - most commonly weapons - are generally unique, and are continuously upgraded to stronger variants. Each upgrade will provide unique traits, abilities, and aspects that can be taken advantage of. Upgrading generally occurs at a chronite forge, though some items might function differently.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Pattern TTP-214L
ResearchProjectDef.description: This research is obfuscated, and cannot be clearly pieced together yet. However, researching what can be understood of it now would provide a massive benefit when it's purpose becomes clear. \n(Dev Note: Unfortunately I wasn't able to finish this before release. I'm working to get this into the mod ASAP, and the research for it will still be valid! Keep an eye on it!)

ResearchProjectDef.label: Basic Metal Reclamation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teaches how to create structures which can recover the dominant metal of specific items that requires standardized technology to access. While the return ratio isn't high, this allows you to recycle items you likely won't have use for, such as guns and machined armor. The ability to recover more resources with higher efficiency is very much possible, but will require more in-depth research.

customUnlockTexts.li: Reclaiming metals from smaller machined items at the terrathyst crucible
Reclaiming metals from larger machined items at the chronite forge
